evidenceSummary: Named Scottish specimens expose an early actinopterygian anatomical mosaic; the study does not define a global first appearance, direct ancestry or detailed ecology.

title.en: Scales and fin supports in an early ray-finned fish
title.zh: 早期辐鳍鱼的鳞片与鳍支撑结构

text.en:
Eifelian Cheirolepis material from Scotland preserves a combination of internal and external features. The named specimens show peg-and-socket scales, an imperforate propterygium—the leading basal support of the pectoral fin—and an imperforate hyomandibular shaft in the skull’s jaw-supporting region. These details let the study compare the fish’s endoskeleton as well as its outer covering.

The fossils document an early actinopterygian anatomical combination; they do not make Cheirolepis a fixed blueprint for all later ray-finned fishes. The value of the sample lies in the specific structures preserved and the comparisons they permit, not in treating one early genus as a direct ancestor of the whole radiation.
text.zh:
苏格兰的埃菲尔期 Cheirolepis 材料同时保存了内部和外部结构。具名标本显示了嵌合式鳞片、无穿孔的前鳍基板——也就是胸鳍前缘的基部支撑结构——以及头骨中无穿孔的舌颌骨骨干；舌颌骨位于支撑颌部的区域。这些细节使研究者既能比较鱼体内骨骼，也能观察外部覆盖。

化石记录的是早期辐鳍鱼的一组解剖特征，并未把 Cheirolepis 定为所有后期辐鳍鱼的固定蓝图。样本的价值在于具体保存了哪些结构，以及这些结构允许怎样比较，而不是把一个早期属当作整个辐射演化的直系祖先。

overview: Two named Middle Triassic specimens of Fukangichthys longidorsalis preserve cranial, scale and CT-visible skeletal characters. Their analysis places the scanilepiform on the polypterid stem, changing one estimate of the ray-fin crown minimum by 45 million years; that shift depends on the tested topology, not a directly observed origin.

traits: Fused skull roof plate with a short triangular nasal region
Large square-like scutes before the epaxial caudal lobe
Fewer than 18 principal caudal rays and no hypaxial procurrent rays
evidenceSummary: The named type specimens and their diagnosis support the stem-teleosteomorph identification. Their lower Anisian Rüdersdorf horizon is about 244 Ma; it is one locality sample, not a global first appearance or a date for the origin of teleosts.

text.en: Holotype MB.f.18641 and paratypes MB.f.19904–19906 establish the species. The diagnosis describes a fused skull roof with a short triangular nasal region, large near-square scutes before the upper tail lobe, fewer than 18 principal tail rays and no lower-side procurrent rays. One described specimen is about 55 mm in total length and 36 mm in standard length.
text.zh: 正模 MB.f.18641 和副模 MB.f.19904–19906 构成该种的模式样本。诊断描述了融合的头盖及短三角形鼻区、尾鳍上轴叶前的大型近方形盾片、少于 18 条主要尾鳍条，以及缺少下侧前行鳍条。一件描述个体全长约 55 毫米，标准体长约 36 毫米。

title.zh: 一个地点限定了证据范围

text.en: The type material was collected at Rüdersdorf in Germany's Central European (Germanic) Basin, from the lower Anisian middle Muschelkalk, dated in the study to about 244 Ma. The paper describes a restricted marine-basin setting. This locality does not establish a global distribution, diet, or swimming performance.
text.zh: 模式材料采自德国 Rüdersdorf，属于中欧（Germanic）盆地的下安尼期中部 Muschelkalk；论文将其定年为约 244 Ma，并描述为受限海相盆地环境。这个地点不能确立全球分布、物种食性或游泳性能。

commonNameZh: 安尼期真骨鱼总群干群鱼
overview: Barschichthys ruedersdorfensis is a lower Anisian stem teleosteomorph known from skull-roof specimens and a partial head and trunk from Rüdersdorf, around 244 Ma. The remains preserve a broad lobed skull-roof margin, cranial ornament, ganoid scales and a long lower jaw with small conical teeth. A partial trunk is about 50 mm standard length; the diagnosis estimates about 80 mm total length.
overviewZh: Barschichthys ruedersdorfensis 是安尼期早期的真骨鱼形类干群鱼，依据约 244 Ma 的 Rüdersdorf（吕德斯多夫）头骨顶材料及一件不完整头部和躯干标本建立。化石保存宽阔的叶状头顶前缘、头骨饰纹、硬鳞和带小圆锥齿的长下颌。部分躯干标本标准体长约 50 毫米；物种诊断给出的全长约 80 毫米。

traits: Broad lobed anterior skull-roof margin without the usual triangular nasal region
Fused, ornamented skull-roof plate with median and lateral extrascapulars
Ganoid scales and a long lower jaw bearing small conical teeth
evidenceSummary: MB.f.19907–19909 support a distinct species diagnosis at Rüdersdorf, including the approximately 50 mm standard-length partial specimen. The roughly 244 Ma point is a local sample; it does not establish a global range, direct ancestry or a feeding guild.

readerLimitations.en: The locality and marine basin setting describe the known sample, not a global range. Feeding comparisons do not identify this species’ prey, and aquatic anatomy is not a measurement of swimming performance or proof of a trophic guild.
readerLimitations.zh: 地点和海相盆地环境描述的是已知样本，并非全球分布。进食比较没有确定该物种的猎物；水生鱼类形态也不是游泳表现测量，更不能据此指定营养生态位。

evidenceSummaryZh: MB.f.19907–19909 支持在鲁德斯多夫建立一个独立物种的鉴定，其中包括一件标准体长约 50 mm 的不完整标本。约 244 Ma 是当地样本记录；它不能确定全球分布范围、直接祖先关系或摄食生态类群。

头顶骨片融合并具纹饰，带有中部和侧部副头盾骨。
硬鳞，以及带有小型圆锥齿的长下颌。

commonNameZh: 安尼期真骨鱼总群干群鱼
overview: Ruedersdorfia berlinensis is represented by three ornamented skull roofs from the Lower Anisian Muschelkalk at Rüdersdorf. The fossils support a distinctive skull anatomy, but preserve no body outline from which to reconstruct the whole fish.

ecology.diet: Unavailable from the preserved skull-roof material
ecology.habitat: Marine restricted Central European Basin (Germanic Basin); life-habitat preference unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Unavailable from the preserved skull-roof material
ecology.bodySize: Skull roofs are about 18 mm long and 11 mm wide; whole-body size is unavailable
ecology.guild: Unresolved; the preserved material does not support a trophic assignment

traits: Fused skull roof with an orbital region nearly as long as the postorbital region
Short nasal region and short middle pitline
Characteristic ganoine ornamentation and exposed conical epiotics
evidenceSummary: The type and referred skull roofs document a fused, ornamented skull with a diagnostic feature combination. The taxon remains Teleosteomorpha incertae sedis, an uncertain placement within that broader fish lineage; ecology and global range are not established.

title.en: A skull roof supplies the diagnosis
title.zh: 诊断依据来自头顶骨盖

text.en: The holotype MB.f.19910 and paratypes MB.f.14888 and MB.f.19911 are skull roofs, not complete fish skeletons. Their fused roof has an orbital region nearly as long as the postorbital region, a short nasal area and middle pitline, and distinctive surface ornament. These features form a combination used to recognize Ruedersdorfia berlinensis; they do not reveal its full body shape, diet or swimming style.
text.zh: 正模 MB.f.19910 与副模 MB.f.14888、MB.f.19911 都是头顶骨盖，并非完整鱼类骨架。融合的骨盖具有近乎等长的眼眶区与眼后区、较短的鼻区和中部感觉沟，以及独特表面纹饰。这组特征用于识别 Ruedersdorfia berlinensis，却不能揭示全身轮廓、食性或游泳方式。

title.en: The fossils have a place and an uncertain branch
title.zh: 化石有产地，支系位置仍不确定

text.en: The skull roofs come from the Rüdersdorf mine in Germany’s Central European Basin and are placed in the Lower Anisian, at about 244 Ma in the cited study. The authors place the fish within Teleosteomorpha but leave its more exact position uncertain. This local sample neither defines a global range nor establishes an early member as an ancestor of later teleosts.
text.zh: 这些头骨材料来自德国鲁德斯多夫矿区，属于中欧盆地，论文将其置于安尼期早段、约 244 Ma。作者把该鱼归入真骨形类，但更精确的位置尚不确定。这一处地方材料既不能划定全球分布，也不能证明较早的成员是后世真骨鱼的祖先。

overviewZh: Ruedersdorfia berlinensis 由三件带饰纹的头顶骨标本代表，产自鲁德斯多夫下安尼期的穆舍尔卡克灰岩。化石支持其头骨具有独特形态，但没有保存可用于重建整条鱼身体轮廓的材料。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模和归入标本的头顶骨片记录了融合、具纹饰的头骨及一组诊断性特征。该分类单元仍被列为 Teleosteomorpha incertae sedis，即在这一较大的鱼类支系中的系统位置尚不确定；其生态和全球分布范围也未确定。

overview: CT scans expose structures inside Cheirolepis fossils; comparisons of living genomes test relationships between gars, bowfin and teleosts. These approaches answer different questions. A molecular estimate of genome duplication adds a timescale, while remaining distinct from the dates of fossil specimens.
overviewZh: CT 扫描让 Cheirolepis 化石内部的结构显现；现生基因组比较则检验雀鳝、弓鳍鱼与真骨鱼的亲缘关系。这两种方法回答不同的问题。基因组复制的分子年代又增加了时间线索，但它仍不同于化石标本的年代。
evidenceSummary: At Tynet Burn and Gamrie in Scotland, late Eifelian specimens of *Cheirolepis trailli* supplied a rare view inside an early ray-finned fish. High-resolution CT scans of named museum material revealed parts of the braincase, jaw suspension and pectoral-fin endoskeleton, including an imperforate propterygium—the leading bone of the paired fin—and scales with peg-and-socket joints. These are observations from a sampled fossil, not a complete body plan for Actinopterygii. The 390.4–388.1 Ma interval is the biostratigraphic age assigned to the Achanarras Limestone on the study's cited timescale, not a direct date on the specimens or a global first appearance.
evidenceSummaryZh: 苏格兰 Tynet Burn 与 Gamrie 的晚艾菲尔期 *Cheirolepis trailli* 标本，为观察早期辐鳍鱼内部结构提供了少见材料。研究者用高分辨率 CT 扫描具名馆藏标本，显露脑颅、悬颌结构和胸鳍内骨骼的部分结构；其中包括无孔的前鳍骨（成对鳍前缘的骨）以及具有榫槽式关节的鳞片。这些是已取样化石的观察，不是辐鳍鱼类的完整身体蓝图。研究引用的 390.4–388.1 Ma 是按其采用的时间标尺赋予 Achanarras 石灰岩的生物地层年龄，并非对标本直接测年或辐鳍鱼类的全球首现。

title.en: A Devonian fin skeleton complicates the early picture
title.zh: 泥盆纪鳍骨让早期形态不再简单

text.en: At Tynet Burn and Gamrie in Scotland, late Eifelian specimens of *Cheirolepis trailli* supplied a rare view inside an early ray-finned fish. High-resolution CT scans of named museum material revealed parts of the braincase, jaw suspension and pectoral-fin endoskeleton, including an imperforate propterygium—the leading bone of the paired fin—and scales with peg-and-socket joints. These are observations from a sampled fossil, not a complete body plan for Actinopterygii. The 390.4–388.1 Ma interval is the biostratigraphic age assigned to the Achanarras Limestone on the study's cited timescale, not a direct date on the specimens or a global first appearance.
text.zh: 苏格兰 Tynet Burn 与 Gamrie 的晚艾菲尔期 *Cheirolepis trailli* 标本，为观察早期辐鳍鱼内部结构提供了少见材料。研究者用高分辨率 CT 扫描具名馆藏标本，显露脑颅、悬颌结构和胸鳍内骨骼的部分结构；其中包括无孔的前鳍骨（成对鳍前缘的骨）以及具有榫槽式关节的鳞片。这些是已取样化石的观察，不是辐鳍鱼类的完整身体蓝图。研究引用的 390.4–388.1 Ma 是按其采用的时间标尺赋予 Achanarras 石灰岩的生物地层年龄，并非对标本直接测年或辐鳍鱼类的全球首现。

title.en: A living-genome comparison places Holostei beside teleosts
title.zh: 现生基因组比较将全骨鱼置于真骨鱼旁

text.en: One phylogenomic study combined 243 one-to-one protein orthologs from 25 jawed vertebrates with bowfin transcriptome data and a spotted-gar genome. Its supported tree places Holostei (gars plus bowfin) as the sister group of Teleostei. The genome assembly came from one wild-caught adult female spotted gar from Bayou Chevreuil, St. James Parish, Louisiana, sequenced at 90× coverage. This is an inference from a defined set of living genomes and transcriptomes; it is not a fossil date or a sample of every ray-finned lineage.
text.zh: 一项系统基因组研究结合了 25 种有颌脊椎动物的 243 个单拷贝直系同源蛋白、弓鳍鱼转录组和斑点雀鳝基因组。其有支持度的系统树将全骨鱼类（雀鳝类与弓鳍鱼）置于真骨鱼类的姐妹群位置。基因组组装来自一只在美国路易斯安那州圣詹姆斯堂区 Bayou Chevreuil 野外采集的成年雌性斑点雀鳝，测序覆盖度为 90×。这是依据特定现生基因组和转录组样本得到的推断，不是化石定年，也未取样所有辐鳍鱼谱系。

title.en: A genome duplication predates crown-teleost estimates
title.zh: 基因组复制早于真骨鱼冠群的估计年代

text.en: A separate molecular-clock analysis used 30 teleost ohnologue pairs—duplicate genes retained after a whole-genome duplication—to estimate the teleost-specific 3R event at 286.18–267.20 Ma. In the same analysis, the crown-Teleostei interval was 254.36–234.16 Ma. These are 95% highest-posterior-density model intervals, not fossil occurrences or a single observed instant. Their separation is compatible with delayed rediploidization and does not support 3R as a deterministic cause of later teleost richness.
text.zh: 另一项分子钟研究使用 30 对真骨鱼同源复制基因（全基因组复制后保留下来的重复基因），估计真骨鱼特有的 3R 事件发生于 286.18–267.20 Ma。同一分析将真骨鱼冠群的年代估为 254.36–234.16 Ma。这些是模型给出的 95% 最高后验密度区间，不是化石产出或一个被直接观察的瞬时事件。两个区间之间的时间差与延迟再二倍化相容，但不支持把 3R 当作后来真骨鱼丰富度的决定性成因。

title.en: The dated record and its limits

text.en: The evidence-linked Actinopterygii navigation envelope starts at 390.4 Ma, the older edge of the late Eifelian interval represented by CT-scanned Cheirolepis trailli specimens, and extends to living ray-finned fishes at 0 Ma; it is not a global class FAD or a claim that Cheirolepis was a direct ancestor.
text.zh: 有证据连接的辐鳍鱼类导航范围从 3.904 亿年前开始，这是 CT 扫描的 Cheirolepis trailli 标本所代表晚艾菲尔期区间的老端，并延续到 0 Ma 的现生辐鳍鱼；它不是该纲的全球首现，也不表示 Cheirolepis 是直系祖先。

title.en: The spotted gar genome illuminates vertebrate evolution and facilitates human-teleost comparisons
title.zh: The spotted gar genome illuminates vertebrate evolution and facilitates human-teleost comparisons

scope.en: A phylogeny from 243 one-to-one proteins in 25 jawed vertebrates, including a spotted-gar genome and bowfin transcriptome data, supports living Holostei (gars plus bowfin) as sister to Teleostei; this is a topology inferred from the sampled living genomes, not a fossil date or a complete sample of Actinopterygii.
scope.zh: 25 种有颌脊椎动物的 243 个一对一直系同源蛋白分析，包括斑点雀鳝基因组和弓鳍鱼转录组，支持现生全骨鱼类为真骨鱼类的姐妹群；这是取样现生基因组的拓扑推断，不是化石年代或辐鳍鱼的完整取样。
